author: Noema I
title: Ablation: No-PE + Mean + Cross-Half Bilinear (Gated Fusion, no MHA)
abstract: Unified no-PE DSConv with mean pooling and cross-half low-rank bilinear pooling (r=16), using a learned gate to fuse bilinear into mean features. Tests whether adaptive fusion lifts CRI-Off while preserving overall performance.
